# Built-in maps

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| world.json | Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 countries, **India point-of-view edition** (borders as officially claimed by India), simplified | Public domain |
| india.json | Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 states (36 states and UTs), outline completed to India's official boundary (Ladakh / Jammu and Kashmir), simplified | Public domain |
| usa.json | us-atlas 3.0.1 `states-10m` (US Census Bureau cartographic boundaries), simplified | ISC (LICENSE-us-atlas) |
| places.json | Natural Earth populated places (cities ≥30k people, all Indian and US entries) — name, ISO country, state, lat, lon, population | Public domain |

The split between the UTs of Ladakh and Jammu and Kashmir in the areas outside Indian administration is approximate.
For an exact official map (e.g. Survey of India), upload it as a custom map: Dashboards › any map widget › Manage maps.
